investment_theses.thesis: Rotate from mega-cap AI beneficiaries (NVDA, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN) into energy (XLE, CVX, XOM) as AI ROI skepticism mounts and geopolitical supply shocks lift oil/gas tailwinds.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Intel -25%, Amazon -7%, hyperscaler free-cash-flow pressure from trillion-dollar AI buildout
CNBC: Chevron/Exxon beat earnings on diesel margin surge; Iran tanker mine strikes + refinery bombing driving supply shock
BBC: $500B Google plunge on AI search ad cannibalization
investment_theses.counter_view: AI capex is still accelerating; energy upside is cyclical and vulnerable to demand destruction if recession hits; oil geopolitical premium could deflate quickly if Hormuz tensions de-escalate.
investment_theses.expression: Long XLE (Energy Select ETF) or CVX; short NVDA call spreads or reduce GOOGL/MSFT overweight in portfolio

investment_theses.thesis: Bitcoin and crypto-native assets face near-term liquidation pressure from Binance hack fallout ($1.5B in forced selling, $3B frozen) and China Xi anti-corruption purges signaling macro tightening, but MicroStrategy's $30B credit capacity and corporate treasury accumulation create a floor around $55–60K.

CoinDesk: Standard Chartered sees more pain, India crypto exchange curbs futures

investment_theses.thesis: Midterm election blue wave is priced in; market reprices sharply on November 4–5, 2026 if Republicans hold House or split Congress, creating volatility alpha. Democracies' historical tendency to re-elect party in power in midterms is being ignored.
investment_theses.horizon: 6 months to election, 1–2 week post-election repricing
supporting_signals: CNBC: Wall Street braces for Democratic gains; investors preparing for blue wave
Implied volatility in equity options and policy-sensitive sectors (healthcare, energy, finance) suggests consensus is priced in
investment_theses.counter_view: Trump approval ratings remain stable; House Republicans have historical midterm tailwinds; blue wave is the true base case and already baked into positioning.
investment_theses.expression: Long VIX calls (Nov 2026 expiry) or long straddles on IWM (Russell 2000) or XLF (Financials) for post-election volatility; short overweight Treasury or gold if red-wave surprise occurs

investment_theses.thesis: Reddit turnaround is undervalued; forced login requirement + API monetization + cost cuts (evidenced by weak guidance) position it as a post-earnings recovery play once Q1 2027 guidance lifts. Google search traffic loss is real but creates defensibility against search competition.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Reddit posts weak sales guidance + login requirement test; Google search traffic shrinking (positive for Reddit moat)
Reddit's plan to monetize user data + AI training partnerships (OpenAI, etc.) is early-stage revenue driver
investment_theses.counter_view: Login requirement drives user churn faster than ads monetize; AI training partnerships face regulatory risk; weak guidance signals structural challenge, not temporary friction.
investment_theses.expression: Long RDDT calls (Jan 2027 $35 strike) or outright position if stock falls further post-earnings; hedge with puts if login friction data shows user loss > 5% cohort
